name: local-basic
source:
if local x=42 then assert(x==42) end
print("ok")

name: const-basic
source:
if const x=42 then assert(x==42) end
print("ok")

name: local-annotation
source: if local x: number?=42 then math.abs(x) end

name: const-annotation
source: if const x: number?=42 then math.abs(x) end

name: table-annotation
source:
if local t: {x:number}={x=42} then assert(t.x==42) end
print("ok")

name: function-annotation
source:
if local f: (number)->number=function(v) return v end then assert(f(42)==42) end
print("ok")

name: trivia
source:
if
-- condition
local
-- name
x
=
42
then
print(x)
end

name: const-trivia
source:
if const -- name
x = 42 then print(x) end

name: outer-initializer
source:
local x="42"
if local x=tonumber(x) then assert(x==42) end
assert(x=="42")
print("ok")

name: outer-else
source:
local x="outer"
if local x=nil then assert(false) else assert(x=="outer") end
print("ok")

name: independent-elseif
source:
if local x=nil then error("bad") elseif const y=42 then assert(y==42) else error("bad") end
print("ok")

name: ordinary-elseif
source: if false then error("bad") elseif local x=false then error("bad") elseif true then print("ok") end

name: nested-statements
source:
if local t={x=42} then if const x=t.x then assert(x==42) end end
print("ok")

name: expression-local
source:
local result=if local x=42 then x else 0
print(result)

name: expression-const
source:
local result=if const x=42 then x else 0
print(result)

name: expression-elseif
source:
local result=if local x=nil then x elseif const y=42 then y else 0
print(result)

name: expression-nested
source:
local result=if local t={x=42} then (if local x=t.x then x else 0) else 0
print(result)

name: initializer-expression
source: if local x=if true then 42 else 0 then print(x) end

name: zero-truthy
source:
if local x=0 then assert(x==0) else error("bad") end
print("ok")

name: empty-truthy
source:
if local x="" then assert(x=="") else error("bad") end
print("ok")

name: false-falls-through
source: if local x=false then error("bad") else print("ok") end

name: first-result-only
source:
local function pair() return false,42 end
local result=if local x=pair() then "bad" else "ok"
print(result)

name: evaluate-once
source:
local count=0
local function nextValue() count+=1; return count,42 end
if local x=nextValue() then assert(x==1) end
assert(count==1)
local result=if local x=nextValue() then x else 0
assert(count==2 and result==2)
print("ok")

name: closure-capture
source:
local f
if const x=42 then f=function() return x end end
assert(f()==42)
local g=if local x=43 then function() return x end else function() return 0 end
assert(g()==43)
print("ok")

name: const-table-mutation
source:
if const t={x=1} then t.x+=1; assert(t.x==2) end
print("ok")

name: mutable-shadow
source:
if const x=1 then do local x=2; x+=1; assert(x==3) end end
print("ok")

name: contextual-const
source:
local const=42
if const then assert(const==42) end
assert((if const then const else 0)==42)
print("ok")

name: contextual-const-call
source:
local const=function() return true end
if const() then print("ok") end

name: initializer-name-not-bound
source: if local x=x then print(x) end

name: initializer-compound-outer
source:
local x=42
if local x=true and x then assert(x==42) end
print("ok")
